object.attr: as implemented: files that someone else changed or staged stay out of the commit. When a commit is refused is in MELLON-VER-SRS. If MELLON-MCP-SRS-84 is accepted, this gains its condition.
object.description: When a write tool call with a `commit_message` succeeds, the MCP server shall commit exactly the files in the call's `affected_files`, with `commit_message` as the message.
